study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Fang et al., Journal of Affective Disorders, 2024
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individualized gray matter morphological abnormalities uncover two robust transdiagnostic biotypes

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics (CNP) [UCLA-LA5c] as discovery dataset; Center for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE) as validation dataset 1; site 20 of the Depression Imaging Research Consortium (DIRECT) as validation dataset 2; Southwest University adult lifespan dataset (SALD) [SINGLE-SITE] for normal structural covariance network construction.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: The discovery dataset was obtained from the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics (CNP) ... The validation dataset 1 was obtained from the Centre for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE) ... The validation dataset 2 was obtained from site 20 of the Depression Imaging Research Consortium (DIRECT) ... we utilized another extensive dataset from a single site (SALD), comprising 492 healthy individuals aged 19-80 years.
